# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Confirmed the pending shrimp-routing amendments were already present in the current `tank_core` implementation: shrimp feeding already guards routed organic-mass consistency, mortality routing already keeps dead biomass closed-loop at `death_biomass_to_detritus_fraction = 1.0`, and invalid serialized fractions are already rejected by invariants/save-load coverage. The only new code change in this execution was a small cleanup in `crates/tank_core/tests/tracing.rs` that replaced explicit `drop(sink)` calls with scope-based sink lifetimes so `cargo clippy -p tank_core --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes alongside the full `cargo test -p tank_core` suite.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Inspect the pending shrimp-routing amendments, current `tank_core` source, and the affected regression coverage to determine whether the requested implementation work was still missing in the workspace.
1. [Skipped] Apply any missing shrimp-routing source changes for the feeding mass invariant, mortality detritus routing, and `death_biomass_to_detritus_fraction` validation; skipped because the current workspace already contained those implementation changes.
2. [Completed] Clear the remaining validation blocker by updating the tracing tests to use scope-based `JsonLinesSink` lifetimes instead of explicit `drop(sink)` calls so package-level clippy can run cleanly.
3. [Completed] Run targeted amendment checks plus full `tank_core` formatting, tests, and clippy validation to confirm the approved shrimp-routing implementation and surrounding regressions remain green.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_core step_hours_rejects_sub_unity_death_biomass_fraction_without_export_path -- --exact` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core malformed_v4_save_with_out_of_range_death_biomass_fraction_is_rejected -- --exact` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --lib systems::shrimp::tests::shrimp_feeding_caps_total_intake_on_routing_mass_basis -- --exact` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test shrimp_feeding_pathway` passed (8 tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test water_change_mass_balance` passed (10 tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_core` passed across the full `tank_core` package.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- `cargo fmt --all --check` passed.

## Outstanding Risks

- The unrelated untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory remains in the worktree and was left untouched.
- This pass reran `tank_core` validation only; `tank_data` and `tank_scenarios` were not rerun because no tracked changes were required there.
